record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.context_brief: Surface examples with pseudo-effective tangent bundle
record.original_question: Does the blow-up of a Hirzebruch surface at four general points have pseudo-effective tangent bundle, and what can be said about blow-ups of Hirzebruch surfaces at special points?

evidence.quote: The remaining problem in the classification of surfaces is as follows: Problem 4.6. — • Does the blow-up of Hirzebruch surfaces at general four points have the pseudo-effective tangent bundle? • What can we say for the blow-up of Hirzebruch surfaces at special points?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Hirzebruch surface is the smooth projective surface $\mathbb{F}_e = \mathbb{P}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1} \oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-e))$ for an integer $e \geq 0$. For a smooth projective variety $X$, the tangent bundle $T_X$ is called pseudo-effective if the tautological line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}(T_X)}(1)$ on the projectivized bundle $\mathbb{P}(T_X)$ is a pseudo-effective line bundle, i.e., its class lies in the closure of the cone generated by classes of effective $\mathbb{R}$-divisors.

(a) Let $X$ be the blow-up of a Hirzebruch surface $\mathbb{F}_e$ at four points in general position. Determine whether the tangent bundle $T_X$ is pseudo-effective.

(b) For blow-ups of Hirzebruch surfaces at points in special (non-general) position, classify which such blow-ups have pseudo-effective tangent bundle.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., a 2023 study on smooth projective surfaces with pseudo-effective tangent bundles) addresses related cases such as blow-ups of Hirzebruch surfaces at up to three general points and blow-ups of non-rational ruled surfaces, but no source found resolves the four-general-points case for Hirzebruch surfaces, nor provides a complete classification at special points. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Smooth projective surfaces with pseudo-effective tangent bundles
status_evidence.snippet: Studies blow-ups of ruled surfaces and surfaces with pseudo-effective tangent bundle, but does not resolve the four-general-points case on Hirzebruch surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature addresses up to three general points and non-rational ruled cases, leaving the four-general-points Hirzebruch case unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On compact Kähler manifold with strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Treats blow-up of Hirzebruch surface at three general points having strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle.
status_evidence.claim: The three-point case is handled in the literature, suggesting the four-point case is the next open step.
